decisions.reason: The DPA management software draws on the firm's documented compliance know-how and its focus on agencies, and positive agency feedback plus continued page presence show the firm can read the early results and refine the product, matching its stated compliance direction.

As the flagship management platform built on the firm's containerized architecture and integrated tooling, and featured on the home page in both years, it is core to the firm's agency-platform strategy and its own R&D.

The configurable managed hosting plan sits squarely within the firm's established hosting competence and owned infrastructure, so it is easy to assimilate and adjust, and it stayed on its own page into 2024.

Extended PHP security support uses the firm's specialized technical teams and security expertise to serve agencies with legacy projects, but its mere mention in 2024 and its tie to particular PHP version lifecycles make it more likely to be reshaped or folded into other offers.
